'''Hideout Pass''' was an area of [[Brzo's Wells]], within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]] around [[3627 BBY]]. It was patrolled by gangsters from the [[Exchange]] Crime Syndicate, who were expanding unto Mek-Sha.<ref name="TOR:NN" />
